title: Vein World
description: This mod add new world, vein world
body:
[development has been stopped due to loss of original files]

This mod adds a new dimension with new ore mobs and a boss.

The mod is still in development, and if you find any bugs, please contact us by email a1ex353@yandex.ru

In this mod, you'll be immersed in a world of wasteland and radiation. The usual laws of survival don't apply there. You'll need to mine new ores and fight walking stones. Then, when you're ready, craft armor from Mavmite, you can fight the boss of this dimension (there's only one now).
This project will be ideal for playing with friends!
To play with this mod, I recommend installing JEI 

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

This mod adds a new dimension with new biomes such as Ironar, Korrat, Charge Korrat, Vald, Oridian, and Ignium.

This mod adds ores for Vald, Vald Iron, Vald Lapis, Vald Gold, Vald Redstone, Vald Gunpowder, and Vald Copper, as well as the same ores for the Oridian biome.

Creatures have been added for all of the above-mentioned ores.
They attack the player, and gunpowder stones have a chance to explode. New ores include rich versions of lapis lazuli, redstone gold, and copper (they yield more resources than regular ores).
Added tegid ore, tarvos protonis, and mavmite ores.
Only mavmite ore can be used to craft tools and armor.
Armor can be upgraded using a forge table.
Also, a radiation effect has been added for korrat.

To fight the boss, you need to create a dend and right-click on the block. This will summon a boss who is immune to a lot of damage, potions, fire, arrows, etc.
After the boss fight, you'll receive an item that can be combined with Mavmite armor and a Tarvos Block on a forge table to upgrade the armor.

</details>
